15 Indian tourists die in Vietnam boat capsize; captain arrested

A speedboat carrying 32 Indian tourists capsized off the coast of Vietnam's Phu Quoc island, resulting in the deaths of 15 Indian nationals. Several others were injured. Vietnamese authorities have arrested the boat captain following the incident, with investigations underway to determine the cause. Efforts are being made to repatriate the deceased and assist the injured tourists.
